exposure: GDM group (satisfactory control and unsatisfactory control)
Resistin (RETN) expression in serum and subcutaneous adipose tissue
outcome: Resistin mRNA and protein expression in adipose tissue
cohort: 43 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) undergoing cesarean section at 37-40 weeks gestation and 24 healthy pregnant women at 37-40 weeks gestation
finding: Resistin expression in both serum and adipose tissue was higher in women with GDM compared to healthy controls and correlated with increased insulin resistance, suggesting resistin may be an important cytokine in GDM pathogenesis.
